KEYWORDS FOR WRITING as
We saw in Writing 02 on pp. 122-123 that as is
sometimes used to mean while. As is also commonly
used to mean because:
As your English is so good, could you do me a big
favour and look through it carefully to check it's OK?
I'd be really grateful as l'Il have loads of luggage.

PRACTICE
A Work in pairs. Write two short emails making
requests. One should be to a hotel or company and
the other should be to your partner. Use as much
language from this writing unit as you can.
B Swap your emails with your partner. Write a reply to
each one.
